scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Ah, I sense you have endured
a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
啊，我能感觉到，你经历过前世。
进入瓦尔哈拉之前，你一定学到了许多东西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Unfortunately, I don't think you're ready to become an Acolyte yet. Please finish learning all of the Basic Skills first.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
很遗憾，我觉得你还没准备好成为服事。
请先学会所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
In the meantime,
I will wait until
you are ready.
May God be
with you.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
我会在这里等你准备好。
愿上帝与你同在。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I welcome you
back from Valhalla and
wish you luck on your
new life's journey.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
欢迎你从瓦尔哈拉归来。
愿你在新的人生旅途中一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth and seek those who need your help. May God light your path.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
现在，出发去寻找那些需要帮助的人吧。
愿上帝照亮你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Now, venture forth to seek people who need your help. May God enlighten your way.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
现在，出发去寻找那些需要帮助的人吧。
愿上帝指引你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I sense that you have endured a past life experience. You must have learned many things before entering Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
我能感觉到，你经历过前世。
进入瓦尔哈拉之前，你一定学到了许多东西。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
However, I can tell that you are not suited to be an Acolyte. Please remember who you were in your past life and find your path.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
然而，我能看出你不适合成为服事。
请铭记你前世的身份，找到属于你的道路。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
What is it that you seek?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你所寻求的是什么？

scripts.text: Father, I want to be a Acolyte.
scripts.translation: 神父，我想成为服事

scripts.text: Acolyte Requirements.
scripts.translation: 成为服事的条件

scripts.text: Just looking around.
scripts.translation: 只是随便看看

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Are you feeling okay today? I can tell by your attire that you are already an Acolyte. You're not joking around, are you?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你今天还好吗？
看你的装束，你已经是服事了。
你不是在开玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I'm sorry, but we can only accept Novices as applicants for the job change to Acolyte.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
很抱歉，我们只接受初心者申请转职为服事。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you truly
wish to become
a servant of God?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你真的愿意成为上帝的仆人吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Oh, you've come back. Let me check and see if you are ready to serve God. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
哦，你回来了。
让我看看你是否已经准备好侍奉上帝...
嗯...

scripts.text: Yes Father, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，神父，我愿意

scripts.text: Nope, I lied.
scripts.translation: 不，我骗你的

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Good. I accept {0}'s will to become an Acolyte. You understand that you must do penance before you can become a servant of God, right?
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
很好，{0}，我接受你成为服事的志愿。
你明白，在成为上帝的仆人之前，必须先完成苦修，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I will
give you a mission...
Please visit ^000077Father Rubalkabara^000000, a member of the Prontera Parish, and return here. He has been practicing asceticism in the ^000077Relics NorthEast of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
那么，我给你一个任务...
请去拜访普隆德拉教区的^000077鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父^000000，然后回来。
他正在^000077普隆德拉城东北方的遗迹^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I will
give you a mission...
Please visit ^000077Mother Mathilda^000000 and then return to me. She has been practicing asceticism near ^000077Morocc Town, SouthWest of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
那么，我给你一个任务...
请去拜访^000077玛蒂尔达修女^000000，然后回来找我。
她正在^000077普隆德拉城西南方的梦罗克镇附近^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Well, I will
give you a mission...
Please visit ^000077Father Yosuke^000000 and return here. He has been practicing asceticism around ^000077a bridge somewhere NorthWest of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
那么，我给你一个任务...
请去拜访^000077阳介神父^000000，然后回来。
他正在^000077普隆德拉西北方某座桥附近^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
May the grace of God light your path and guide you during your journey of penance.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
愿上帝的恩典照亮你的道路，指引你完成苦修之旅。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
You lied?
It is good that you
have confessed your
wrongdoing. Go in
peace, my son.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你撒谎了？
能坦白自己的过错，是件好事。
平安地去吧，我的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Good Lord! Haven't you accomplished the Basic Training yet?! It's important that you finish that!
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
天哪！
你还没完成基础训练吗？！
完成训练很重要！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Oh? I can't find your name on the Registration List.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
哦？
我在报名名单上找不到你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Hmm...
Your name is on the list and you've proven your qualification.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
嗯...
你的名字在名单上，也已经证明自己具备资格了。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
You should have trained more! Go back and make sure you reach Novice Job Level 9 and learn all of the Basic Skills!
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你还需要多加训练！
回去把初心者的职业等级练到9级，并学会所有基本技能！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please visit ^000077Father Rubalkabara^000000, a member of the Prontera Parish, and return here.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
请去拜访普隆德拉教区的成员^000077鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父^000000，然后回来。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He has been practicing asceticism in the ^000077Relics at the NorthEast of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
他正在^000077普隆德拉城东北方的遗迹^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please Visit ^000077Mother Mathilda^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
请去拜访^000077玛蒂尔达修女^000000，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
She has been practicing asceticism near ^000077Morocc Town, located SouthWest of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
她正在^000077普隆德拉城西南方的梦罗克镇附近^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please visit ^000077 Father Yosuke ^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
请去拜访^000077 阳介神父 ^000000，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He has been practicing asceticism near a ^000077bridge somewhere to the NorthWest of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
他正在^000077普隆德拉西北方某座桥附近^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
May the grace of God brighten your path and guide you on your journey of penance.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
愿上帝的恩典照亮你的道路，指引你完成苦修之旅。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
I am proud to say that you are now ready to become an Acolyte!
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
我很自豪地告诉你，你现在已经准备好成为服事了！

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Always remember to be thankful to God, who is taking care of us all the time.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
要时刻心怀感恩，上帝始终照顾着我们。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Always use your gifts to serve Him by helping others. In chaos and times of difficulty, face your hardships with unwavering faith.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
要运用自己的天赋帮助他人，以此侍奉上帝。
即使身处混乱与困境，也要以坚定不移的信仰面对苦难。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Lastly, I want to sincerely congratulate you on persevering through your trial of penance.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
最后，衷心祝贺你坚持完成了苦修的考验。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Do you wish to become an Acolyte? You must fulfill two requirements.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你想成为服事吗？
你必须满足两个条件。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
First, you have to reach at least Novice Job Level 9 and learn all of the Basic Skills. Second, you will be given a trial of penance to overcome.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
首先，初心者的职业等级必须达到9级以上，并学会所有基本技能。
其次，你必须通过苦修的考验。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
For your trial, please visit ^000077Father Rubalkabara ^000000 and then return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你的考验是去拜访^000077鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父 ^000000，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
For your trial, please visit ^000077Mother Mathilda^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你的考验是去拜访^000077玛蒂尔达修女^000000，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
For your trial, please visit ^000077Father Yosuke^000000 and return here to me.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
你的考验是去拜访^000077阳介神父^000000，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
The destination for this trial will be decided once you fill the application form.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
等你填好申请表，就会确定这次考验的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He is practicing asceticism in the ^000077Relics at the NorthEast of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
他正在^000077普隆德拉城东北方的遗迹^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
She has been practicing asceticism near ^000077Morocc, located to the SouthWest of Prontera City^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
她正在^000077普隆德拉城西南方的梦罗克附近^000000苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
He has been practicing asceticism around a bridge somewhere ^000077NorthWest of Prontera^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
他正在^000077普隆德拉西北方^000000某座桥附近苦修。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
May the grace of God light your path and guide you on your journey of penance.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
愿上帝的恩典照亮你的道路，指引你完成苦修之旅。

scripts.text:
[Father Mareusis]
Please come back after fulfilling the two requirements I've asked of you. As long as your desire to serve God and others is sincere, you will be able to make it.
scripts.translation:
[马鲁西斯神父]
满足我提出的两个条件后，再回来吧。
只要你真心愿意侍奉上帝、帮助他人，就一定能做到。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Please take care. They should know that you've met me by the time you arrive at the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
路上小心。
等你回到普隆德拉圣堂，他们应该就知道你已经见过我了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...? You must be the one who aspires to become an Acolyte. I've already received news from the Sanctuary that you might be coming.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦...？
你就是想成为服事的那个人吧。
圣堂已经来信，说你可能会来。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh...
Are you one of the
Acolyte applicants...?
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦...
你是申请成为服事的人吗...？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Huh? What brings you here? This is a very dangerous place for a Novice like yourself!
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
咦？
你怎么来这里了？
对你这样的初心者来说，这里很危险！

scripts.text: [Father Rubalkabara]
scripts.translation: [鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Greetings.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Oh ho...
Have you come into the Deep here for training? Or are you just a Wanderer?
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
哦呵...
你深入这里是为了修行，还是只是四处游历？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I've sent a carrier pigeon with a message. I hope it will arrive there safely...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我已经用信鸽传了消息。
希望它能平安抵达...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Now, your name was {0}, right? Excellent, thank you for visiting me.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你叫{0}，对吧？
很好，谢谢你来看我。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I believe you've been told much about Acolytes from Friar Mareusis. Plus, there's plenty of helpful people in the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我想马鲁西斯神父已经向你介绍了不少关于服事的事情。
普隆德拉圣堂里也有许多乐于助人的人。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
I guess there's really no need for me to teach you much. Besides, I'm sure your someone from your generation may have trouble listening to an old man like me. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
我想，也没多少东西需要我来教你了。
况且，你们这代年轻人，恐怕不太听得进去我这个老头子的话吧。
哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Still, lessons may come from the places you'd least expect. God loves to teach his children in strange ways. You'll see.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
不过，有时你会从最意想不到的地方学到东西。
上帝喜欢用奇妙的方式教导祂的孩子。
你会明白的。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Well, I'll send the message telling them that you've come to visit me. So, you may now return to the Prontera Sanctuary.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
好了，我会传消息，告诉他们你来拜访过我。
现在可以回普隆德拉圣堂了。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
再见。

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Your name is {0}?
I don't think your name
is on my list. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你叫{0}？
我的名单上好像没有你的名字。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Why don't you go back to the Prontera Sanctuary and check again?
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
你不如回到普隆德拉圣堂再确认一下吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Welcome to the Deep. Feel free to sit and contemplate God's message with me. This place is beautiful, even if danger accompanies its sense of serenity...
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
欢迎来到这片幽深之地。
不妨坐下来，和我一起思索上帝的教诲。
这里很美，虽然宁静之中也潜藏着危险...

scripts.text:
[Father Rubalkabara]
Whoever you are, please take care of yourself. The monsters in here are shockingly strong, contrary to their cute appearance.
scripts.translation:
[鲁巴尔卡巴拉神父]
无论你是谁，都请小心。
这里的魔物外表可爱，实力却强得惊人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a carrier pigeon to the Prontera Sanctuary. When you return, the Priest there should already have received my message.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会用信鸽给普隆德拉圣堂传消息。
等你回到那里，牧师应该已经收到消息了。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah, you must be one of the Acolyte applicants. I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
啊，你一定是申请成为服事的人吧。
诚挚地欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Ah...!
You must be one
of the Acolyte applicants.
I sincerely welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
啊...！
你一定是申请成为服事的人吧。
诚挚地欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
...

scripts.text: [Mother Mathilda]
scripts.translation: [玛蒂尔达修女]

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hello there~
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你好~

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
May God
be with you...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
愿上帝与你同在...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will pray to God, and hope that you become an Acolyte soon.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会向上帝祈祷，希望你能早日成为服事。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
What is your name? {0}? Let's see... Ah, you're on my list.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你叫什么名字？
{0}？
让我看看...
啊，你在我的名单上。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
I will send a message to the Sanctuary confirming that you, {0} visited me and completed your penance.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
我会通知圣堂，确认{0}已经拜访过我，完成了苦修。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Please return to the Prontera Sanctuary and speak to the Priest in charge.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
请回普隆德拉圣堂，找负责此事的牧师谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Now, what is your name?
{0}? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你叫什么名字？
{0}？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Hmm...
It seems your name
is not on my list...
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
嗯...
看来，你的名字不在我的名单上...

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
Perhaps you should return to the Prontera Sanctuary and check the destination for your penance trial once again.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
也许你该回普隆德拉圣堂，再确认一下苦修考验的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Mother Mathilda]
How is your practice coming along? I certainly hope you're enjoying living in the grace of God.
scripts.translation:
[玛蒂尔达修女]
你的修行进展如何？
愿你在上帝的恩典中生活得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
What?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
什么？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
Whatever you are,
you look like an
Acolyte applicant.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿，不管你是谁，看起来倒像是来申请当服事的。
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey.
You look like an Acolyte Applicant. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿，你是来申请当服事的吧？
我说得对吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You...
Novice.
There something
you wanna tell me?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你...初心者。
有什么话想跟我说？

scripts.text: [Father Yosuke]
scripts.translation: [阳介神父]

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Hey...
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
嘿...

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Do you have anything to say? Because unfortunately for you,
I don't any replies.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你有什么话要说吗？
可惜，我没什么可回答你的。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Have you any more business with me?! You don't! Go back to the Sanctuary now!
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你还有事找我吗？！
没有了吧！
快回圣堂去！

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad, not bad. You withstood the penance trial pretty well.
So what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
不错，不错，苦修的考验你完成得很好。
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
{0}，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Okay. I'll send a message to the Sanctuary that you, {0}, came to visit me.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
好，我会通知圣堂，说{0}已经来拜访过我了。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Now go back to the Santuary and finish becoming an Acolyte, kid.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
孩子，快回圣堂去，完成服事的转职吧。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
Not bad at all, you've made it all the way here from Prontera. So what's your name, kid?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
不错嘛，孩子，你从普隆德拉一路走到这里了。
你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
{0}, huh? Why isn't your name on my list?
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
{0}，是吧？
怎么名单上没有你的名字？

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
You probably made a mistake. Go back to the Santuary, and check with the Bishop.
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
你大概搞错了。
回圣堂找主教确认一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Father Yosuke]
If you like, come sit here with me and meditate the great truths. God's majesty is truly inspiring...
scripts.translation:
[阳介神父]
愿意的话，就坐下来，和我一起思索伟大的真理吧。
上帝的威严，实在令人心生敬畏...
